requests.summary: I ran 5 lanes in 1 round(s) and asked for 1 independent re-check(s), always for the strongest development gain. These replicated: e002 (The readings follow a damped oscillation exp(-g t) (A cos(w t) + B sin(w t)) + C with an u). These improved on the development data but were not re-checked or did not replicate, so they are not findings: e001. The current best is e002, which replicated. The re-check says only pass or fail, so I report no size for the gain. Caveat: one task, a small pool of measurements, and the development numbers are optimistic because they were used to choose lanes.
